Eye Pattern - Cracked-Light Irises.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Cracked-Light Irises
Irises shot through with bright, fracture-like lines of light — as if the iris were cracked and glowing from behind.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Cracked-Light Irises.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply cracked-light iris patterns, as if fine glowing fractures run through the iris. Keep the effect inside the eyes. Do not create a full aura or active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
